mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200) signals reduced purchasing power and higher real interest rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 200.

mechanism_narrative: The joint effect of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200) creates a monetary tightening regime that compresses equity valuations, yielding negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and CPIAUCSL > 200.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), tight labor market conditions support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market expansion (HOUST > 1500) signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1500.

mechanism_narrative: The joint effect of high housing starts (HOUST > 1500) and strong residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 360000) indicates a robust housing sector that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 360000.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production level (INDPRO > 110) indicates strong economic activity supporting corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 110.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) causes immediate equity market pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
